t: World Poker Tour: WPT Legends of Poker
d: Poker veterans Toto Leonidas and Prahlad Friedman lead the attack at the final table of the Legends of Poker as six poker pros go after a WPT title and a million dollar payday.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Legends of Poker
d: The Legends of Poker main event hurtles to a thrilling conclusion in Los Angeles as four players battle to be the last man standing and the proud owner of the million dollar first place prize.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Borgata Poker Open
d: The largest field in World Poker Tour history produces a final table with one of the biggest WPT personalities ever as hard drinking, fun loving, trash talking Jumbo Pressure Jeremy Brown tries to bully his way to a win on the WPT.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Borgata Poker Open - Part 2
d: Trash talking New Yorker Jeremy Brown continues to put on a show as he steamrolls his opponents on a seemingly unstoppable path to one of the most dominating wins in WPT history.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Festa al Lago - Part 1
d: Two time WPT champion Freddy Deeb returns to the bright lights of the World Poker Tour final table in search of an elusive third win and yet another million dollar payday.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Festa al Lago - Part 2
d: High stakes tournament poker can be a cruel game and this episode of the WPT demonstrates just how fickle Lady Luck can be.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Foxwoods World Poker Finals - Part 1
st: WPT Foxwoods World Poker Finals - Part 1
d: Madman Soheil Shamseddin returns to the WPT arena crazier than ever and ready to gamble his way to a WPT title.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Foxwoods World Poker Finals - Part 2
st: WPT Foxwoods World Poker Finals - Part 2
d: It's a two on two poker game in Foxwoods as a couple of very talented representatives of the new breed of players take on two old guard Texas gamblers at the final table of the Foxwoods World Poker Finals.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Foxwoods World Poker Finals - Part 3
st: WPT Foxwoods World Poker Finals - Part 3
d: An epic WPT final table comes down to two Texas gamblers in Soheil Shamseddin and Cornel Cimpan versus one young gun in the fearless Matt Stout.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Five Diamond World Poker Classic
st: WPT Five Diamond World Poker Classic
d: Every year the Five Diamond World Poker Classic showcases the best poker players in the business and Season Eight is no exception as World Champion Scotty Nguyen headlines a fearsomely talented final.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Five Diamond World Poker Classic - Part 2
st: WPT Five Diamond World Poker Classic - Part 2
d: Fresh off his second place finish at Bellagio earlier in the season, Faraz The Toilet Jaka is back in Las Vegas and determined to not come up short once again.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Southern Poker Championship - Part 1
d: A bunch of good ol' boys from down south and one New York City lawyer tangle in a high stakes poker match on the banks of the Mississippi.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT Southern Poker Championship - Part 2
d: The action heats up down South as the Alabama Cowboy Hoyt Corkins looks to write his name in the record books by notching his second career WPT title.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT L.A. Poker Classic - Part 1
d: In Los Angeles money means power and there is plenty of power up for grabs at the final table of the Los Angeles Poker Classic as first and second place both earn over $1,000,000.

t: World Poker Tour: WPT L.A. Poker Classic - Part 2
d: The biggest WPT tournament of the year comes down to its final four and the action doesn't stop from the first hand to the last.
